title: A router fallback is recorded as unrouted, not routed
acceptance: A pull request whose router answer is unparseable, missing or off the menu keeps the fallback route skip/minor/records and is written with reason unrouted, never routed; a pull request the router chose to skip stays routed.
digestProblems admits unrouted on both sides of the branch, still refuses an unknown reason and an included change whose reason is not routed, and every digest already published still admits.

The page's How this was chosen says "Left out: the router's answer for it could not be read"; the issue tables the reason and says how many were unrouted under its table; the run log counts the unrouted pull requests, and a run where every answer fell back says so as its reason for writing nothing.
The first-pass score is unchanged by a fallback.

Red first (2 failed), green; red again with a value check in place of the identity check (1 failed), restored. Same targeted command: 10 files, 225 passed.
